featured_reviews.name: Subeer Datt Verma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Before I was introduced to Dr Upendra Bhalerao, I had been suffering from very severe aortic stenosis. I also had a congenital bicuspid aortic valve. The cardiologist I was consulting, at the time, cautioned me that I was facing “sudden death” and I required immediate AVR surgery.

After years of neglecting the advancing disease, mostly through ignorance of the ramifications, I went into state of panic and desperately sought a surgeon who would reassure and guide me, give advice on the prosthetic valve options, costs, recovery process, risks, etc. To my dismay, I found that anyone I contacted (through strong references) were unwilling to guide me or, else, were inaccessible. “Contact my secretary, for an appointment” was the most typical response. I was at the height of my desperation when I was introduced to Dr Bhalerao, by a mutual acquaintance, late in October 2024. Our first interaction was for 5 minutes, after which I forwarded all my recent lab reports to him. We had a video consult lasting 27 minutes, on 28th October, by the end of which my respect for him was firmly established.
We had several conversations, over the next two months and he was generous with his time, gently explaining the positive outcomes and risks of the surgery, in detail and unambiguously. By now, my faith in him was unshakeable.

By the time I checked in at Jaslok Hospital, for surgery scheduled on 8th January, 2025, I was confident, assured and unafraid. Dr Bhalerao’s constant refrain, “you’re going to be fine” had buoyed my spirits and I was actually looking forward to the surgery!

Dr Bhalerao had me on my feet within 2 days and ready to go home within 7. I am now exactly 3 months past the date of surgery and each week I achieve a new landmark in the recovery process.

I am deeply indebted to Dr Bhalerao: undoubtedly, he is a surgeon par excellence. More than that, he is a human being par excellence.

featured_reviews.review_text:
**Subject: Feedback and Suggestions for Improvement**

Dear Sir/Madam,

I would like to share my feedback regarding the services at the hospital.

1. **Doctors' Services**
All doctors are providing very good care and support. I am satisfied with their services.

2. **Nursing Staff**
All the sisters (nurses) are doing an excellent job and are very caring and supportive. However, in my opinion, they seem to have an excessive workload. It may be beneficial to increase the number of nursing staff to ensure even better patient care.
Sister DIPIKA AND ANILA IS ALSO GIVING EXCELLENT SERVICE.

3. **Housekeeping**
The housekeeping services are good. However, compared to other hospitals such as Saifee Hospital, there is room for improvement in terms of cleanliness follow-up and maintenance.

4. **Security System**
The security system is also good, but some changes may be required. For example, certain patients, such as children with Cerebral Palsy (CP), require two attendants to manage and care for them. This creates difficulties for families. We have had admissions at Saifee Hospital and Masina Hospital several times, and such facilities were available there.

I would especially like to appreciate the security staff, particularly **Deepali Madam** and **Jhone Madam**, who are extremely cooperative, helpful, and supportive.

5. **Food for Patient Attendants**
One of the most important concerns is the food available for patient relatives/attendants. The food served in the SRCC canteen, especially the regular vegetable dishes, lacks taste and variety, and the chapatis are often very hard. There are very limited options available. As attendants stay with patients for long periods, they also require proper and nutritious food; otherwise, they themselves may fall sick.

6. **Billing and Budget**
The hospital expenses and billing are very high. I kindly request the management to review the billing structure and explore ways to control and reduce costs for patients and their families.

I had submitted a similar application previously, but unfortunately, I did not receive any reply or response. I would appreciate it if my feedback could be reviewed and acknowledged.

Thank you for your attention and consideration.

**Thanks & Regards**
